0.1.0.summary: Initial multi-distro release with modern patchbay canvas, dynamic cable routing, and Catppuccin theme
changes: Modal navigation tools (V: Select, H/Space: Hand/Pan, Q: Marquee box)
Dynamic cable color gradients with Bezier, Straight, and Stepped routing formulas
Unified Catppuccin category colors and role badges (SOURCE, SINK, HW)
Synchronized dual-view Mini Rack & Patchbay with bidirectional scroll/focus
Session safety with rotating background autosaves and exit prompt protection
Pre-built multi-distro packages for Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch Linux, Void (glibc & musl), Alpine, and Nix

installation.arch: Install via AUR / PKGBUILD: `paru -S clara-git` (or extract `clara-archlinux-*.tar.zst` to `/usr`)
installation.ubuntu: Download `.deb` and run: `sudo dpkg -i clara-ubuntu-*.deb && sudo apt-get install -f`
installation.fedora: Download `.rpm` and run: `sudo dnf install clara-*.rpm`
installation.nix: Run directly via Flake: `nix run github:acropolis914/Clara`
